checks.statement: Only candidate SemanticControlEdge is a new formal output; no graph schema exists.
The payload has exactly from/to/candidate_id/guard_ref/context_ref/feasibility/region_ref.
Every candidate feasibility is UNRESOLVED.
Endpoints are SemanticAction occurrences or ENTRY/EXIT, never raw CFG block identities.
Identity uses endpoints plus region/context and path-alternative provenance and is reorder stable.
Distinct occurrences and distinct context/path alternatives are not collapsed.
Edges are first-next candidates; A-B-C does not add transitive A-C.
Carrier blocks compress and branch/join/loop/dispatcher cases retain expected candidates.
Every candidate resolves structural and applicable region/context/propagation evidence; no global all-pairs rule exists.
P1-T4 validate/query APIs and node/context cache are consumed directly; propagation is not rerun.
FIXED_POINT is not feasibility; reached UNKNOWN and missing cache entries remain distinct.
RESOURCE_LIMIT retains covered candidates, PARTIAL/TRUNCATED accounting, and exact frontier.
UNSUPPORTED, ERROR, and upstream PARTIAL cannot become empty COMPLETE.
No-region functions use normal Fact CFG candidates without fabricated region or propagation artifacts.
Same-block order uses complete SFIR semantic_ids evidence; missing order emits explicit alternatives and diagnostics.
guard_ref contains only traceable unrefined source condition refs; no normalized Guard exists.
No SMT/solver/SAT/UNSAT/opaque refinement runs; solver stays NOT_RUN.
No Def-Use/RD/VFG/dependency/order/STIR/source-identical CFG work was added.
Accounting is reproducible and reorder stable; production has no oracle/evaluator import.
P1-T5/P1-T4/P1-T2/P1-T1 targeted suites and the 31-entrypoint runner pass.
Report, evidence, PROJECT_STATUS, implementation, tests, and P1-T6 handoff agree.
